title: UI tokens
summary: UiTokens (colours, spacing, radii, font sizes) + a Theme built from them, UiButton/UiPanel/UiModal/UiText components, and a test that fails on hardcoded colours/sizes
claude_md: - UI: never hardcode colours or sizes; use `UiTokens` and `scenes/ui/components/` (UiButton, UiPanel, UiModal, UiText). The `ui` suite enforces it.
